assessment: inventory.py:6-12 checks availability against current batch-local stock before any deductions. A shortage appends False and continues without mutation. Successful orders deduct all items; earlier successes persist. Equality succeeds and an empty order succeeds because any over an empty item list is False.

The stock copy, integer arithmetic and ordered result construction preserve caller inputs, integer counts and result order for the validated input contract. Nested order data is only read. Both API signatures and return shapes remain intact.

batch.py and command_codec.py are unchanged from HEAD. The adapter validates the entire batch before calling reserve; shortages add no validation policy or exception. Unique known SKUs and reusable validated item lists make the precheck sound.

The new regression checks all six batch prefixes through both APIs, including a sufficient first item followed by a shortage, preservation of prior success, continuation, exact depletion, empty order/batch, exhaustion, copied stock, nested input immutability and integer/boolean types. Expected intermediate stocks would expose partial deductions or checking original stock instead of remaining stock.

The invalid JSON regression checks malformed text and shape, ID, SKU and quantity failures, including an invalid order after a valid prefix; mocked reservation must remain uncalled. Existing six tests remain intact.
